Maharashtra, the state of Mumbai, is by far the most affected by the pandemic in India and even this new wave is relentless. The Virar incident follows that of two days ago in Nashik, also in Maharashta, where in another hospital 24 Covid-19 patients died of suffocation due to an oxygen tank failure that left the intensive care unit without supplies with patients attached to artificial ventilators.
